thread:
maya: taking over from @sam — saw the pager for embeddings-east1 at ~12:07 UTC. 5xx spike, some timeouts. I'm taking driver now, will keep it until handoff is clean. brief below.

incident-bot: Pager alert: embeddings-service-east1 latency/5xx surge (P1) — 2026-02-28T12:07:12Z — 37% 5xx over 5m. Incident page: https://incidents.redwood/3490012345

sam: handing off context: spike started ~11:58 after a scheduled bulk-encode job. autoscaler didn't restore capacity fast enough (quota hit). I already set a partial route fallback to quantized-model-a and reduced batch window for incoming encodes.

toni: thanks — any confirmed customer impact?

maya: yes — 3 VIP customers reported timeouts via CS; bulk of traffic degraded latency (200-1200ms -> 1.5-6s for some requests). Not a full blackout but user-visible.

lee: which runbook section did you use? want to make sure we capture steps for postmortem.

maya: followed embeddings runbook -> "embeddings: burst mitigation". Actions executed: 

```
/infra scale pool embeddings-east1 --min 6 --burst 10
```

and route override: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/route/override -d '{"route":"embeddings","to":"quant-a","weight":40}'
```

alex: I'll take comms if maya is driver. I'll post an incident status in #status and ping CS.

maya: thanks. @alex please post an initial customer-facing line: impact, mitigation, ETA. keep it short.

alex: Posted to #status: "Investigating embeddings latency in us-east; partial mitigation in progress; some VIP requests impacted. Next update in 10m." :loudspeaker:

incident-bot: Incident note added: mitigation=route-override, pool-scaled=true, autorun=blocked-by-quota.

sam: autoscaler logs show quota errors — excerpt: 

```
[autoscaler] 2026-02-28T11:59:02Z ERR insufficient-gpu-quota: requested 8, available 2
```

maya: opened infra ticket INF-4821 (insufficient GPU quota). pinged infra-team and included the log snippet.

toni: coverage: my shift ends in ~25m. I can't extend. who will cover until morning?

maya: i'm available for ~30m, then will hand to @lee. lee — can you pick primary at 12:40 UTC?

lee: I can take primary at 12:40 but need a quick list of pending items to pick up.

maya: pending items for handover:
- verify autoscaler backfills (INF-4821)
- confirm 5xx rate trending down (goal <2% sustained 10m)
- revert route override once stable or schedule automated revert in 1h

maya: I also temporarily adjusted alert thresholds to reduce noise (5% -> 20% 5xx) while we stabilize. note in timeline.

alex: comms update: CS notified customers A,B,C and opened portal notice. will escalate if any VIP opens a ticket.

lee: confirmed — I'll take driver at 12:40 and continue monitoring. alex keep comms.

maya: adding explicit handover note to runbook timeline: 

```
handover:
- driver: lee
- comms: alex
- notes: INF-4821, route override -> quant-a (40%), autoscaler logs attached to incident page
```

sam: FYI leave a reminder to revert routing after 1h if stable (or add to cadence for canary rollback).

maya: done. added a deferred task to incident timeline to revert route in 60m unless flagged.

toni: small QA note — capture the promptset used for the bulk encode; we should attach it to the evals run to check quality regression from quant-a.

maya: will capture promptset and upload to incident artifacts.

alex: I'll post the next public update when 5xx < 2% for 10m or earlier if there's a notable change.

incident-bot: Incident status changed -> monitoring. Last action: route override applied by maya.

maya: handing over to @lee now (12:40 UTC). leaving driver context and commands in thread. thanks team.

lee: taking driver. will continue the watch & will escalate if INF-4821 has a blocker.

alex: noted — comms remains active. final note: include INF-4821 ref in postmortem. :white_check_mark:
